summary: Correct BUG-0095 with live SMB/NFS folder picking and iSCSI target selection. API impact: existing contract for the picker; compatible source-name validation expansion uses the existing storage discovery and registration contracts.

guide.reason: Document destination browsing, confirmation, cancellation and manual fallback with the actual picker labels.

api.reason: Describe root versus directory requests, original NFS export ownership and supported source-name semantics without new endpoints or durable relay state.

roadmap.reason: Corrects the existing storage discovery workflow; does not complete an additional milestone or change pool/migration/HA acceptance.

state.reason: Picker navigation and discovery results are transient. Existing accepted storage registrations and credentials remain Core-owned with unchanged inventory/adoption.

verification.method: Run focused backend and built-UI browser regressions, exercise the actual SMB/NFS/iSCSI disposable Core lab, and inspect screenshots; exact results and limitations are recorded in the QA report.
